sent_to_model:
I just spent the weekend away with friends for motorcycle racing and I want to write about it on my blog. Can you help me put together a post, around 450 words, catching everybody up on the races and the funny stuff that happened with our group? I also ended up taking a motorcycle ride after being totally against it, so that's a pretty big development for me! I'm back in the office now and already wishing I was somewhere else. I'd like to include that, my plans to get some riding gear, and a little excitement about our next trip to Kern River.

- Trip centered on motorcycle races at Laguna Seca; watched racing for two days.
- Planning to buy steel-toed boots this coming weekend for motorcycle riding.
- Kern River trip coming up in one week.
- Christi's car had a hood problem beside the 46 at about 2am.
- Race seats were beside the track in the Aprilia tent.
- Back at work; first complete working week in roughly a month.
- 8ball had mentioned these races a couple of months earlier; attending mattered a lot to him.
- 8ball repaired the hood using duct tape, a strap and a screw from a license plate.
- Wine tasting was another activity during the weekend.
- Christi's car was green.
- Want Laguna Seca race weekend to become a yearly vacation.
- Cory and 8ball entertained everyone with their walkie-talkie conversations.
- Initially refused a motorcycle ride out of fear; eventually agreed after 8ball kept encouraging me.
- Enjoyed riding with 8ball and now want another ride.
- Sister very insistent that I get protective footwear before more motorcycle riding.
- Watching racers corner and accelerate along the straight sections was impressive.
- At the office, spending more time emailing than actually working.
- Expected two days of motorcycle racing to be boring; surprised by how much I enjoyed watching.
- Very enthusiastic about wine and loved that part of the trip.
- Unhappy to be back at work; wish I had a job with generous paid time off.
- Great weekend overall, with especially good seats for the racing.
- Still concerned about getting hurt on a motorcycle; want 8ball to ride carefully with me.
- Share the weekend's memorable events with blog readers and express excitement about the next outing.

(About me: office worker and personal blogger. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

must_cover: Describe the motorcycle races at Laguna Seca and the funny things that happened with the group.
Describe overcoming fear to ride with 8ball and plans to buy protective footwear.
Express disappointment about returning to office work.
Mention excitement about the upcoming Kern River trip.

reference.kind: a real piece of writing by a real person
